items.title: Polymarket Senate and oil combo market leads with oil above 85 dollars and a Democratic Senate at 52 percent
items.content_text: - **Polymarket Senate and oil combo market leads with oil above 85 dollars and a Democratic Senate at 52 percent** — Polymarket's combined market on Senate control and oil below 85 dollars before the midterms has traded 234,500 dollars since launching on October 12. The leading outcome pairs oil at or above 85 dollars with a Democratic Senate at 52 percent, followed by oil above 85 dollars with a Republican Senate at 26 percent. items.title: Kalshi social post coincided with a move in its own 2028 Ossoff market, analysis finds
items.content_text: - **Kalshi social post coincided with a move in its own 2028 Ossoff market, analysis finds** — Prediction Markets Picks reports that after Kalshi Politics posted about Senator Ossoff alongside its 2028 market, Ossoff slipped a point to 11 percent on Kalshi's 2028 winner board while Newsom and Vance ticked up. The piece raises the governance question of an exchange amplifying public facts next to prices on its own contracts, while noting nothing in the CFTC framework bars it. ([Prediction Markets Picks](https://predictionmarketspicks.com/articles/kalshi-ossoff-tweet-should-exchanges-move-their-own-markets))

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs take in 175.7 million dollars on October 13 after a heavy weekly exodus, TradingNews reports
items.content_text: - **Bitcoin ETFs take in 175.7 million dollars on October 13 after a heavy weekly exodus, TradingNews reports** — TradingNews reports IBIT and FBTC pulled in 175.7 million dollars on October 13 after a week of outflows, while on-chain Bitcoin demand rebuilt by 69,000 BTC after two negative months. items.title: Polymarket Nobel market never listed winner Navi Pillay as a named candidate, TokenPost reports
items.content_text: - **Polymarket Nobel market never listed winner Navi Pillay as a named candidate, TokenPost reports** — TokenPost reports Polymarket's 2026 Nobel Peace Prize market did not list eventual winner Navi Pillay as a named candidate, so her outcome was covered only by a catch-all contract for another person or organization. items.title: RuleGuard tool flags prediction markets that look identical but settle under different rules
items.content_text: - **RuleGuard tool flags prediction markets that look identical but settle under different rules** — A GitHub project called RuleGuard scanned 59,399 open markets across Kalshi, Polymarket, Limitless and Manifold and found 187 pairs that look identical. In a random cross-operator sample, rules fully matched in only 1 of 11 pairs, and among 341 settled Kalshi-Polymarket pairs since 2023, 7 paid out in opposite directions because of rule differences. ([GitHub](https://github.com/aldikbobr/ruleguard))

items.content_text: - **CFTC interim rule excludes traditional sports wagers and casino games from the swap definition** — The TokenPost reported that a CFTC interim final rule issued October 9 excludes traditional sports wagers and casino games from the legal definition of a swap. A separate proposal would classify event contracts tied to sports, politics, culture and weather as swaps under CFTC oversight, with a 30-day comment period once published. items.title: Bitcoin slips back below 81,000 dollars as Fed rate uncertainty weighs, CoinDesk reports
items.content_text: - **Bitcoin slips back below 81,000 dollars as Fed rate uncertainty weighs, CoinDesk reports** — Bitcoin traded just below 81,000 dollars early Thursday after September inflation at 3.7 percent revived talk of an October Fed hike. CoinDesk notes Polymarket October hike odds spiked near 50 percent after the print before easing to about 30 percent, while US spot bitcoin ETFs saw 150.5 million dollars in outflows on October 14. ([CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/10/15/bitcoin-is-back-below-usd81-000-as-fed-rate-uncertainty-weighs))

items.title: Prediction markets become a Supreme Court problem after September volume hit 71 billion dollars, AMBCrypto reports

items.title: Kalshi traders placed 598,464 contracts on the Cardinals draft pick as state regulators review sportsbooks, Gambling Insider reports
items.content_text: - **Kalshi traders placed 598,464 contracts on the Cardinals draft pick as state regulators review sportsbooks, Gambling Insider reports** — Kalshi customers traded 598,464 contracts on Jeremiyah Love being the third pick in the 2026 NFL draft, more than on any other player, according to Kalshi market data cited by Gambling Insider. items.title: Combined Kalshi and Polymarket monthly volume more than doubled to 53 billion dollars by July, CCN analysis says
items.content_text: - **Combined Kalshi and Polymarket monthly volume more than doubled to 53 billion dollars by July, CCN analysis says** — CCN, citing a Pew Research Center analysis of The Block data, says combined monthly volume rose from about 25.7 billion dollars in May 2026 to 53 billion dollars in July, driven largely by sports. items.title: American Gaming Association estimates 1.5 billion dollars in lost state tax revenue in Supreme Court brief
items.content_text: - **American Gaming Association estimates 1.5 billion dollars in lost state tax revenue in Supreme Court brief** — A Virlan roundup of the CFTC swap proposal reports that an October 8 amicus brief from the American Gaming Association estimated unregulated sports prediction contracts have cost states more than 1.5 billion dollars in tax revenue. items.content_text: - **Reuters Ipsos survey finds bipartisan majorities oppose election betting and only 7 percent have used prediction markets** — SCCG reports a Reuters Ipsos poll of 4,506 adults found 69 percent of Democrats and 61 percent of Republicans oppose election betting, while 75 percent of respondents see prediction market trading as gambling. items.title: NBER study finds no systematic political bias in election prediction market prices from 1880 to 2025
items.content_text: - **NBER study finds no systematic political bias in election prediction market prices from 1880 to 2025** — RotoWire reports an October 2026 NBER working paper by Eric Zitzewitz assembled election prediction market data spanning 1880 to 2025, covering venues from the Iowa Electronic Markets and PredictIt to Kalshi. The study found the full-sample bias estimate was essentially zero, with no statistically significant partisan tilt at one-day, three-week or four-month horizons. ([RotoWire](https://www.rotowire.com/article/prediction-markets-go-back-to-future-with-election-trades-139104))

items.title: CFTC moves to classify prediction market contracts as swaps amid state pushback
items.content_text: - **CFTC moves to classify prediction market contracts as swaps amid state pushback** — The CFTC issued an interim final rule excluding casino-style gambling from the swap definition and proposed a rule classifying event contracts on sports, politics, culture and weather as federally regulated swaps. items.title: Oil slips and gold rebounds on October 15 as dollar eases, TradingView reports
items.content_text: - **Oil slips and gold rebounds on October 15 as dollar eases, TradingView reports** — Oil fell more than a dollar in early October 15 trade as traders weighed Hormuz shipping risks against U.S. steps to cut petroleum shipping costs, with Brent near 104.67 dollars and WTI near 94.07 dollars. items.title: Kalshi petitions Sixth Circuit for rehearing while CFTC proposes swap rules, SCCG reports
items.content_text: - **Kalshi petitions Sixth Circuit for rehearing while CFTC proposes swap rules, SCCG reports** — Kalshi asked the full Sixth Circuit to reconsider a September 25 panel ruling that let Ohio and Tennessee pursue gambling-law enforcement against its sports contracts. items.title: New York sued Polymarket US alleging an illegal gambling operation
items.content_text: - **New York sued Polymarket US alleging an illegal gambling operation** — New York Attorney General Letitia James and Governor Kathy Hochul sued QCX LLC, which does business as Polymarket US, alleging the platform operates without a state gambling license. items.title: CFTC October 9 actions draw a line between event contracts and casino or sportsbook wagers
items.content_text: - **CFTC October 9 actions draw a line between event contracts and casino or sportsbook wagers** — On October 9 the CFTC issued an interim final rule and a separate proposal that would treat sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts as swaps under federal derivatives oversight, while casino games and traditional sportsbook wagers stay outside that definition. Federal appeals courts remain divided over sports contract jurisdiction, with the NFL backing state oversight and Robinhood backing exclusive federal authority. ([Cryptonomist](https://en.cryptonomist.ch/2026/10/10/cftc-prediction-markets-regulation-2/))

items.title: Investopedia explainer sets out the federal and state split over prediction market regulation
items.content_text: - **Investopedia explainer sets out the federal and state split over prediction market regulation** — Investopedia explains that the CFTC regulates prediction markets at the federal level and treats event contracts as derivatives, while many states view the contracts, especially sports contracts, as gambling. items.title: Forkast shuts down its esports prediction market after a 100 million dollar run
items.content_text: - **Forkast shuts down its esports prediction market after a 100 million dollar run** — The Esports Advocate reports Forkast announced on October 12 that it is winding down, with withdrawals open until November 9 and automated agent trading pausing October 15. The company says it processed more than 100 million dollars across 1.6 million trades, and outright markets on the League of Legends World Championship, which starts October 15, will be refunded rather than resolved. ([The Esports Advocate](https://esportsadvocate.net/2026/10/forkast-shuts-down-esports-prediction-market/))

items.title: Kalshi and Polymarket combined volume fell 14.5 percent in August to 45.33 billion dollars
items.content_text: - **Kalshi and Polymarket combined volume fell 14.5 percent in August to 45.33 billion dollars** — The Coinomist reports combined monthly volume fell to 45.33 billion dollars in August, the first monthly decline in a year, as World Cup trading cooled. Kalshi posted 37.17 billion dollars, down 7.3 percent from July, while Polymarket and its US platform together recorded 8.16 billion dollars, down 36.7 percent. ([The Coinomist](https://thecoinomist.com/news/kalshi-polymarket-volume-down-14-5-percent-august/))

items.title: Polymarket's Coplan says blockchain made small, specialised event markets viable
items.content_text: - **Polymarket's Coplan says blockchain made small, specialised event markets viable** — The Asian Banker reports Shayne Coplan describing how Polymarket creates markets on events of any size and turns the resulting prices into a public information source. He said blockchain infrastructure let the platform test contracts that traditional derivatives exchanges would have found commercially unattractive to list. items.title: Kalshi weather contracts price Hurricane Isaias ahead of Georgia-Alabama, Action Network reports
items.content_text: - **Kalshi weather contracts price Hurricane Isaias ahead of Georgia-Alabama, Action Network reports** — Action Network reports Kalshi lists three contracts tracking Hurricane Isaias, pricing it at 99 percent to reach Category 3 or higher, 11 percent for Category 4 or above, and 78 percent to cross Alabama before year-end. items.title: Thirty days of esports data finds Polymarket in 13.2 percent of arbitrage cases and Kalshi in 2.8 percent
items.content_text: - **Thirty days of esports data finds Polymarket in 13.2 percent of arbitrage cases and Kalshi in 2.8 percent** — A dev.to analysis of esports prices from September 6 to October 6 across 25 sportsbooks plus Polymarket and Kalshi found about 4.87 million arbitrage cases in total. Polymarket appeared in 642,253 of them and Kalshi in 138,017, while the two prediction markets were mispriced against sportsbooks far more often than against each other. ([dev.to](https://dev.to/dozor/polymarket-kalshi-arbitrage-vs-sportsbooks-30-days-of-esports-data-1dc2))

items.title: SEC clears Cboe KPI options, with Robinhood set for retail launch
items.content_text: - **SEC clears Cboe KPI options, with Robinhood set for retail launch** — The SEC approved Cboe to list binary options tied to company key performance indicators, a securities-market route distinct from CFTC-regulated event contracts. items.title: Reuters reports midterm election betting surge on Polymarket and Kalshi, with public opposition in poll
items.content_text: - **Reuters reports midterm election betting surge on Polymarket and Kalshi, with public opposition in poll** — The Los Angeles Post, carrying Reuters reporting from October 14, says betting on the US midterms has surged on Polymarket and Kalshi as traders buy binary contracts on races and control of Congress. items.title: Bernstein note says owning the exchange is becoming the competitive edge in prediction markets
items.content_text: - **Bernstein note says owning the exchange is becoming the competitive edge in prediction markets** — Finance Magnates reports a Bernstein note finding platforms that once relied on third-party venues are bringing matching, clearing and licences in-house, citing DraftKings launching its own DKeX exchange and Robinhood and Susquehanna routing flow through Rothera. The note says Coinbase reached about 100 million dollars in annualised prediction market revenue within two months of launch. items.content_text: - **Kalshi launches first US stock index perpetual with no expiry, US 500** — CryptoRank reports Kalshi launched its US 500 perpetual future on October 6, described as its first US stock-index perpetual with no expiry date, giving traders leveraged long or short exposure to 500 large companies. items.title: Novig launches nationwide sports prediction market after CFTC contract market approval
items.content_text: - **Novig launches nationwide sports prediction market after CFTC contract market approval** — Novig said its sports prediction market is launching nationwide after CFTC approval as a designated contract market, putting it under federal oversight instead of state by state sportsbook licensing. The company said the launch adds instant live trading, more payment methods and expanded compliance and surveillance controls, with users required to be at least 21. ([DeviceDaily](https://www.devicedaily.com/?p=437872))
